vocabulary.note: 可供替換的零件；本題仍須先驗證特定性能。
keep an order on hold 指暫不繼續處理訂單。

group.title: Confirming a connector alternative
group.passage:
Woman: The original connector will not arrive until next month. Could we use the alternative listed in the component database?
Man: Its dimensions match, but we have not checked the contact resistance yet. Please ask the lab to test it first.
Woman: Understood. I will send five samples to the lab today and keep the purchase order on hold.
Man: Good. We can decide after the results come back on Friday.
group.passageZh:

女：了解。我今天會送五個樣品到實驗室，並暫緩採購單。
男：很好。星期五結果回來後，我們再決定。
